prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1437; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in League City, Texas. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: Yes. Please use the placeholder name Claimant Driver.

Q: Thank you, Claimant Driver. Do you consent to this call being recorded?

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Walk me through what happened at the intersection.

A: I was heading through the intersection on a green light. I had just passed the crosswalk when a vehicle coming from my right pulled out and hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Did the other driver have a stop sign or signal?

A: They had a stop sign. I believe they rolled forward into the intersection without fully stopping, but I'm not completely sure how far they had moved before impact.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: Probably around the posted limit, maybe a little under. I wasn't speeding.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?

A: The side airbag came out on my side. My head didn't hit anything, but my body was thrown against the door and my right arm and shoulder took most of the force.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They X-rayed the shoulder and told me to see an orthopedic specialist because of ongoing pain and limited range of motion.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that shoulder?

A: No, not that I can recall. It had never bothered me before this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm still in physical therapy and I'm missing some work because of the pain. I'll provide the records.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
